items: 【Smart Watch Compatible with iPhone/Android Phones】- This smart watch is compatible with most iOS 9.0 & Android 5.0 or higher smart phones (Not for PC or tablet). Pairing it to your phone, you can answer/make calls and read messages/app notifications(including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Whatsapp, and more) directly on this smartwatch, very practical when you are navigating a busy commute or focused on a gym session. Equipped with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology, this smartwatch ensures a faster, more stable connection and data syncing with your phone.

【Accurate Fitness Tracker with 100+ Sport Modes】- This fitness tracker watch can accurately track your all day calories burned, steps taken, distance traveled. Supporting over 100 indoor and outdoor activities, this fitness watch provides real-time data for a wide range of users—from fitness beginners establishing a routine to active lifestyle enthusiasts who enjoy regular running, cycling, or yoga. Whether you are walking on a treadmill or exploring weekend hiking trails, the comprehensive sports modes ensure every movement is recorded to help you stay motivated and reach your health goals.

【Heart Rate/Blood Oxygen Monitor & Sleep Tracker】- This health tracker watch will auto monitor your heart rate and blood oxygen all day. This watch provides a granular analysis of your Deep, Light, REM sleep, and Awake stages to help you optimize nighttime recovery (tracking primary rest 6 PM – 12:00 noon). It is an ideal wellness companion for busy parents, health-conscious seniors, and anyone looking to maintain a balanced and proactive approach to their daily well-being.

【Customized Watch Faces & All-Day Waterproof Durability】- Express your personality through the 1.85-inch touch screen, which offers 200+ designer watch faces and a creative DIY mode for using your favorite pet photos or selfies. Designed to adapt to your lifestyle, this smartwatch features an IP68 waterproof rating, allowing you to move seamlessly from a high-intensity gym session to daily tasks like hand-washing, walking in the rain or swimming without needing to remove it. It is a perfect accessory for fashion-forward commuters and active families who value both a customized look and a device that can withstand the splashes of everyday life.

【Wellness and Emotional Trend Insights】- Promote a more balanced lifestyle by gaining a better understanding of your daily stress and mood trends. This smartwatch provides visual patterns that help you recognize how your body responds to different environments, whether at work or during rest. When you feel the need for a mental reset, the built-in guided breathing tool offers a simple way to practice mindfulness and find your focus. It is a supportive companion for busy professionals and students looking to stay mindful of their well-being and maintain a positive outlook throughout their journey.

【Smart Watch for Women Men & Thoughtful Gift Choice】- Designed with a changeable and adjustable strap (6.1-9.6 inches), this smartwatch offers a comfortable and secure fit for both men and women. It serves as a comprehensive daily assistant with features such as female menstrual cycle tracking, sedentary reminders, and guided breathing to support a balanced lifestyle. Beyond wellness, it simplifies your day with practical tools like music control, stopwatch, timer and alarms. With its sleek aesthetic and multi-functional design, it is a meaningful gift for friends, active seniors, or family members, helping them stay organized, motivated, and connected to their health goals.

【Health Data Integration and 7-Day Endurance】- Easily sync your daily activity and wellness metrics with popular platforms like Apple Health and Google Fit, ensuring all your fitness records are consolidated in one place. Combined with a powerful battery that supports up to 7 days of continuous use and 30 days of standby on a single charge, this smartwatch minimizes the hassle of frequent charging. It is a reliable companion for busy people who want to maintain a consistent, long-term overview of their health progress without interruptions.
